pr_body:
Backport for #8121

This PR add reviewers to the list of participants of an issue.

Currently, only users that add a plain comment (CommentTypeComment) are counted as participants. If a user adds a review/request changes (CommentTypeReview or CommentTypeCode) they are not considered participants.

Fixes #8122

issue_context.title: Reviewers are not included as participants.
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.9.2

## Description

If a user adds a code review/request changes (CommentTypeReview or CommentTypeCode) they are not listed as participants. Only plain commenters and the issue poster are.
